title: Fruit salad
summary: Colourful, fresh and a good chance for Remy to coach knife skills.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a simple demo. Checked by Matthew on 2026-11-07.
notes: Knife safety: board on a damp cloth so it doesn't slide, fingers in a claw grip, cut flat sides down so fruit doesn't roll.
ingredients: A handful of strawberries or other berries
Squeeze of lemon juice (stops the apple going brown)

steps.instruction: Put a damp cloth under the board so it doesn't slide. Wash the fruit.
looks_wrong: board sliding around on the worktop

steps.instruction: Peel the orange and banana. Cut the apple into quarters, remove the core, then cut every fruit into bite-sized pieces. Cut a flat side first so nothing rolls, and keep your fingers in a claw.
looks_right: flat side down on the board
looks_wrong: round fruit rolling under the knife
fingers flat in front of the blade
steps.done_when: All the fruit is in bite-sized pieces.

steps.instruction: Put everything in the bowl, squeeze over a little lemon juice and toss gently.
